canonical_project: Suihua City Big Data Center Phase I (绥化市大数据中心（一期）)
owner: Suihua city government / China Unicom Heilongjiang (绥化市大数据中心)
notes: Province's first data-resource-aggregation digital base, running since 2019-09-30; selected as 2020 national typical case of new-type (edge) data center, the only Heilongjiang entry. Government procurement (ccgp.gov.cn) shows Phase I O&M service tender in 2026, confirming continued operation. Capacity MW not published.
